questions.question: In which year did Hindustani Classical vocalist Rashid Khan receive the Padma Bhushan award?

The correct option is __**2022**__.

__
 
• Rashid Khan was born on** 1 July 1968** in** Badayun, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He is an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani music tradition and belongs to the** Rampur-Sahaswan gharana**.
 
• He was awarded the** Padma Shri**, as well as the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in** 2006**.
 
• In 2022, he was awarded the **Padma Bhushan Award**, India's third highest civilian award, in the field of Art.
 
• He also won **Global Indian Music Academy Awards (GIMA)** in** 2010** and** Maha Sangeet Samman Award** in** 2012**.

questions.question: Maitya Ram Reang (Satyaram) was conferred with the Padma Shri for his contributions to which of the folk dances?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hojagiri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hojagiri **is a **folk dance**, performed in the state **of Tripura**, **India **by the **Tripuri people **of the **Reang clan.**
 
• It is **performed **by **women **and **young girls**, about **4 to 6 members **in a team, **singing**, **balancing **on an **earthen pitcher**, and **managing **other **props **such as **a bottle on the head **and an **earthen lamp **on **the hand**.
 
• **Satyaram Reang **is an **Indian folk performer **and **folk artist **from **Tripura**.
 
• He is noted for his **significant contribution **to **Hojagiri Dance**.
 
• **In January 2021**, he was **awarded India's fourth-highest civilian award **the **Padma Shri **in the **Arts category**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Gussadi **is an ancient folk dance form of aboriginal tribals. **Dandari **troupes perform it during the festival for a fortnight.
 
• **Sattriya or Sattriya Nritya, **is a major Indian classical dance. It is dance-drama performance art with origins in the Krishna.
 
• The Bihu dance is an indigenous folk dance from the Indian state of Assam related to the Bihu festival and an important part of Assamese culture.

questions.question: Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan, popularly known as the Dhananjayans were awarded with Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for the year __________.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities received the Prestigious National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
